{{Quote|The Senate Guards surely afford more than adequate protection&hellip;|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine|<ref name="Republic 64">[[Republic 64|''Republic'' 64]]</ref>}}
The '''Senate Guard''', colloquially called the '''Blue Guard''', and less frequently the '''Republic Guard''', or sometimes prior to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the '''Coruscant Guard''', was an [[Special forces/Legends|elite]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its duties were to [[Bodyguard/Legends|safeguard]] the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and were based on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and had a tradition that went back thousands of years, making it one of the oldest law enforcement agencies in service to the Republic. It also served as a secondary police force for Coruscant in addition to the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. Next to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the Senate Guards were seen as the defenders of democracy and symbols of peace and security on Coruscant. In law enforcement circles, Senate Guard investigations were well known for meticulous and excellent investigative and forensic work. The Senate Guard's specialized division, the [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]], were the best of the Senate Guard. When not conducting police investigations or taking on secret missions for the Republic government, the Senate Commandos took a leading role in the protection of dignitaries and government property. The Senate Guards were a frequent sight in the halls of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], their ceremonial uniforms and robes helping to blend in with the formal settings. In the waning days of the Republic, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] formed a personnel security detail, the [[Red Guard]], who he favoured over the Senate Guard. He additionally began to phase out the Senate Guard with the [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]. As [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], Palpatine disbanded the Senate Guard altogether and replaced them with his [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and to a lesser extent the [[Imperial Senate Guard/Legends|Imperial Senate Guard]] and [[Imperial Senate Sentinel]]s.

==Description==
===Duties and organization===
{{Quote|While I regret that it had to turn violent, my guards acted per orders and are to be commended. We have a responsibility to the representatives of the Republic. We have hundreds of delegates arriving in the coming days, and we have to make sure they are safe, and to do so, we have to clear those entryways.|Jesra Loture, Captain of the Senate Guard|<ref name="HNN55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|news/1359_1.html|Anti-War Rally Dispersed by Senate Guard}}</ref>}}
[[File:Senate_Guards.png|thumb|left|200px|Senate Guards]]
The Senate Guard was an [[Special forces/Legends|elite]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] that was responsible for defending the [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellors]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Centered on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Senate Guard tradition went back thousands of years and it was as old as the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] itself. Senate Guards were more than just [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] as they were also [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]]. The distinctive and familiar blue armor and robes of the Guard served as symbols of both peace and security in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] for which the Guard operated as a secondary police force. In order to protect the thousands of senators, the Guard was responsible not only for the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], but also the entire [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]]. Senate Guards would also be found on senatorial transports, in order to protect their charges, and conducting secretive government missions. Guards worked to protect senators from external threats such as [[Assassin/Legends|assassinations]] but also from internal threats such as the bribery of senators which Guards had to report to their superiors. As time went on, the Senate Guard became a legacy system with several generations entering the service. Especially in the waning days of the Republic, the legacy system allowed corruption to breed such as senators paying their Guards to look the other way on criminal acts. This, despite the efforts of the loyal [[Senate Guard internal affairs department|internal affairs department]].<ref name="GAW" />

To become a Senate Guard, candidates would go through a full training program while those who had previous experience as planetary police officers would go through a shortened training program. Immediately after graduating, Guards were given the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Private/Legends|private]] and generally assigned to the [[Senate Guard Headquarters]] where they processed [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] and profiled suspects. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporals]] were assigned to protect a prominent senator, a group of less prominent senators, or government VIPs. The [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] handed out bodyguard detail assignments and provided security for the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] which was overseen by the [[Sergeant-at-Arms/Legends|Sergeant at Arms]]. A [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] would oversee a [[Squad/Legends|squad]], composed of two to four Guards. [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]] were responsible for task forces of six to eight guards. The leader of the Senate Guard was called the [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] who answered to a [[Senate Guard committee/Legends|Senate committee]] and officials in the Republic [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]]. The elite of the Senate Guards would become a part of the [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]] division, considered the best and bravest of the Guards. Led by a [[Captain/Legends|captain]], the Senate Commandos were volunteers who were selected and had to undergo a grueling four week combat training program. Often they were called on to perform secret government missions or conducted police investigations. They wore armor that was more functional then their regular Guard counterparts.<ref name="GAW" />

===Training and equipment===
{{Quote|The blue guards started telling everyone to clear the doors, and then people started shouting back. They [the protestors] tried to push back, and that's when the rifles came out.|Lia Reicheds, Senate clerk|<ref name="HNN55" />}}
[[File:SenateGuardCommando-GAW.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Senate Guards in robes and armor.]]
Prospective recruits were cautiously selected from among the most respected law enforcement agencies in the galaxy. Part of the guidelines for selection involved the fact that all candidates must be superb combatants and that they be completely dedicated to the Galactic Republic. The candidates were trained at the [[Senate Guard Academy]] and upon graduation assigned to headquarters<ref name="GAW" /> By the end of the Republic, membership in the Senate Guard increasingly became hereditary, with several generations of some families serving in their ranks. This meant that candidates were often dominated with family connections. However, acceptance was extended to distinguished members from recognized planetary law enforcement bodies. Should that be the case, these more experienced recruits often went through a shortened academy training program.<ref name="GAW" /><ref name="SWRHonor">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Honor and Duty]]''</ref>

The most notable element of the Senate Guard was their symbolic blue robes and helmets. Their blue armor had remained as a trustworthy symbol of both peace and security of the Galactic Capital for thousands of years.<ref name="Senate Guard" /> The design of the armor was inspired by the ancient [[Neo-Crusader armor|armor]] worn by [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|370|Neo-Crusaders, Mandalorian}}</ref> and the [[Notron Centurions]].<ref name="GAW" /> The striking blue robes had another symbolic meaning of representing the supreme authority of the Senate along with its long tradition of a wise and just rule. In addition to the robes, the helmets had large crests and the uniform consisted of simple drapes but these were ceremonial rather than functional.<ref name="EP1:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> In terms of weaponry, new guardsmen were often provided with [[Mk II Paladin blaster rifle/Legends|ceremonial]] rifles that were distinctive, powerful and accurate. These weapons were noted for capable of firing a strong stun blast and while they were known for being primarily ceremonial, they saw increasing usage during the final years of the Republic. Should their mission or security demand it, guardsmen were known to discard their long weapons in order to be outfitted with more practical forms of weaponry.<ref name="DB Senate Guard" /> The Guard were given extensive [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] training and instructed in the use of [[Force pike/Legends|Force pikes]]. They were also drilled in the [[Hijkata/Legends|Hijkata]] [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] discipline. Furthermore, they also utilized enhanced armor compared to one of a clone with a distinct blue paint job. To get around the capital, Senate Guards used a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]. When in more serious situations, the Guard used a heavily armed assault vehicle.<ref name="SWRHonor" />

Among the facilities available, the Republic Guard used fully equipped and modern analysis laboratory's which were used to help them conduct their investigations. In the field, special [[Senate Guard analysis droid|analysis droids]] were used that released their sensitive data only to the appropriate officers.<ref name="SWRHonor" />

===Relationship with other law enforcement===
{{Quote|And you have primacy? I thought the city came under CSF jurisdiction.''"<br />"''Not as long as I have a Senator and his aide in danger.|RC-1309 "Niner" and Commander Obrim|<ref name="Targets">{{InsiderCite|81|Omega Squad: Targets}}</ref>}}
[[File:SenateGuardAdversary-CotR.png|thumb|left|250px|The Senate Guard worked closely with the Coruscant Security Force.]]
The Senate Guard worked most closely with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], though the two had a rivalry. The Senate Guard served as police force for Coruscant, but was secondary to the CSF which had primary jurisdiction of Galactic City. However, in cases involving the safety of senators, the Senate Guard also had primary jurisdiction.<ref name="Targets" /> There were exceptions as the murder of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] was investigated by the CSF, not the Senate Guard.<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>

Among the skills that distinguished the Guard was their use of some of the best investigative and forensic work in capital. However, this had the effect of leading to some among the ranks of the Blue Guard to be distrustful of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as the Guard preferred to deal in cold hard facts. Thus, they often relied on the field of forensic evidence rather than rely on what they believed to be the mysticism of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] sorcery. As such, they were often at odds with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] due to their less tangible methods of evidence gathering.<ref name="GAW" />

With the coming of the Clone Wars the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] was formed to assist the CSF in securing the capitol. The [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] of the Coruscant Guard took over the responsibility of the Senate Guard as Coruscant's secondary police force which diminished the power of the Senate Guard. When the [[Red Guard]] was formed to protect the Supreme Chancellor, the power of the Senate Guard was further diminished.<ref name="GAW" />

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|He comes from generations of Guards on your side as well mine!|Sagoro Autem|<ref name="Republic 46">[[Republic 46|''Republic'' 46]]</ref>}}
The history of the Senate Guard was ancient and was as old as that of the Galactic Senate itself, thus tracing its origin to the ancient times of the Republic. It's known that among the artwork of the earliest times of the Republic, images of silent Guardsmen had been present during these earlier centuries as a silent testament during diplomatic negotiations that force was ready to be used if diplomacy itself failed.<ref name="GAW" />

===Separatist crisis===
[[File:SenateGuards.jpg|thumb|right|170px|Senate Guards attempt to restrain a protester in front of the Senate Building.]]
During the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the Guard was led by [[Jesra Loture]].<ref name="Senate Guard" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] began marginalizing the role of the Senate Guard. Instead of relying on them, he began installing his own elite guard that consisted of red robed warriors that became known as the [[Red Guard]].<ref name="Senate Guard" /> These soldiers were selected from the ranks of the Senate Commandos and took over the responsibility of security for the Chancellor.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The Senate Guard<ref name="ObiwanGuard">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] makes reference to the Coruscant Guard. According to ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'', the Coruscant Guard entry states that it was a title sometimes used for the Senate Guard before the formation of the clone Coruscant Guard unit in 22 BBY. As such, this article assumes Coruscant Guard, in reference to the game, refers to the Senate Guard.</ref> launched an undercover operation to investigate the [[Black Heth]] gang that had been operating on the lower levels. The [[Unidentified Quarren informant|undercover informant]] sent in to investigate was discovered by the gang and held at a constructions site. The Senate Guard requested the assistance of the Jedi and Obi-Wan Kenobi, who had also been investigating the Black Heth, to assist in the rescue the informant. Fighting his way through several Black Heth thugs, Kenobi was able to prevent the execution of the informant who was being questioned as to his true identity. The informant passed on to Kenobi that the Black Heth were importing large quantities of illegal weapons into Coruscant. Kenobi then took charge of the investigation, eventually tracking down and eliminating the smuggling operation.<ref name="SW:OW">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref>
{{Endgame}}

===War begins===
{{Quote|Senate Security Committee wants this ended fast to show Haruun Kal we're in control. They can't just walk in here, grab a Senator, and hold the Republic's finest at bay.''"<br />"''Maybe the Republic's finest, or you to be exact, should have concentrated on ensuring secure transportation for Senators.|Senate Guard Commander Jaller Obrim and CSF Lieutenant Dovel|<ref name="Targets" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the blue-armored Senate Guard were the elite honor guard to high-ranking government officials on Coruscant, and rarely left the capitol except on the most important Senate business.<ref name="GAW" /> In the early days of the war,<ref name="TripleZero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> [[Korun/Legends|Korun]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] under the leadership of [[Nuriin-Ar]] [[Galactic City spaceport hostage siege|seized]] the [[Galactic City Spaceport]] and took several hostages, including Senator [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]] and her [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Vun Merett Jai]]. The terrorists demanded that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] withdraw its forces and cease interference in the [[Summertime War|affairs]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]. The Senator's involvement prompted Obrim and a Senate Guard detachment to respond to the hostage crisis, as did the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] unit [[Omega Squad]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]], and [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata|Null-11]], nicknamed "Ordo."<ref name="Targets" />

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kaim]] attempted to negotiate with the Korun terrorists, but they [[Death/Legends|killed]] him and threw his body, strapped with explosives, outside of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Fi Skirata|RC-8015]], nicknamed "Fi," jumped onto the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] before the explosion went off, an act that saved the lives of the CSF police officers standing nearby. The hostage siege was brought to an end as the commando team forcefully entered the building and killed the terrorists.<ref name="Targets" /> Fi survived the blast, and his heroism was remembered by Obrim and the CSF for a long time thereafter.<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

===Traitor in the ranks===
{{Quote|Count Dooku has paid me a fortune to deliver your slimy carcass, so please try to stay alive.|Faro Argyus, to Nute Gunray|audio=ArgyusTryToStayAlive.flac|<ref name="COD">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref>}}
{{Main|Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends}}
[[File:Argyus_vs_Gree.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Captain Argyus betrays the Republic]]
After the [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|capture]] of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] and an enemy of the Republic,<ref name="Bombad Jedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref> Captain [[Faro Argyus/Legends|Faro Argyus]] along with additional commandos were sent to guard the captive viceroy while he was aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] en route to Coruscant. However, Argyus had been contacted by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and bribed into releasing the viceroy and returning him safely to Separatist [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Not wanting to be forever bound to Republic guardsmen duty, Argyus secretly changed allegiances. During the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} journey, the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] came [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|under attack]] by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] and three [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]], which pierced the hull of the ''Tranquility'', releasing a Separatist boarding party. Eventually, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under the leadership of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] destroyed the invading [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], but they had only been a distraction to allow Separatist [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to infiltrate and cripple the Republic warship.<ref name="COD" />

Ventress briefly rescued Gunray in the detention level, despite Argyus's conveyed attempt to prevent it. Ventress [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] Argyus out of her way, intent on departing with the viceroy. The arrival of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] thwarted Gunray's escape, however, and forced Ventress to flee. Unduli pursued Ventress into the engine room of the ''Tranquility'', leaving [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to guard the captive viceroy alongside Argyus, his commandos, and Gree. Argyus told the Padawan that following one's heart made them distinct from [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. At his urging, Tano went off to find Ventress, leaving Gunray under the watch of Argyus, his men, and Gree. In the course of her engagement with the Jedi, Ventress sent an all-clear signal to Argyus.<ref name="COD" />

His true loyalties revealed to the Republic, Argyus killed his fellow commandos, released Gunray, and took the Neimoidian viceroy as a living shield. Only Gree stood in his way. During the scuffle that followed, Gunray hit the clone over the head with the butt of Argyus's blaster, knocking him unconscious. Argyus signaled Ventress to inform her of his success and he and Gunray made it to a docked [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Rodia)/Legends|''Consular''-class frigate]], which they used to make their escape. Ventress, meanwhile, had eluded the Jedi and entered an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], arriving aboard the escaping [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|cruiser]] before reaching Separatist space. Argyus arrogantly gloated to Ventress about ''his'' mission's success, and that ''he'' had been responsible for Gunray's rescue. Ventress silenced his gloating permanently, [[Shiak|impaling]] him with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and killing him.<ref name="COD" />

===Rampage on Coruscant===
{{Quote|You go, sir.|The Commando sacrifices himself for the Chancellor|<ref name="ZBSB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>}}
[[File:Zillo_Beast_snacks.png|thumb|right|280px|The Zillo Beast spots Palpatine and the Senate Guard]]
After discovering the last known [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] during the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|battle]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], the Republic's scientific community and Chancellor Palpatine both desired to study the beast's invulnerable scales to create impenetrable armor for the Republic's clone troopers. However, they decided to conduct this study on Coruscant, and subsequently transported the heavily sedated beast to the [[Republic Science and Technical Center/Legends|Republic Science and Technical Center]]. Senate Guards accompanied Palpatine as the beast arrived under heavy guard. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]], throughout the course of her examination of the beast, found that she couldn't remove the Zillo Beast's scales without harming it. On briefing Palpatine of this, he ordered her to kill it, angering the Zillo Beast. Later, during the attempted execution, the beast escaped from the facility and began a [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|rampage]] across Coruscant. As alarms began wailing across Coruscant, orders were given for the Senate staff to evacuate to the lower levels. Upon the Zillo Beast's arrival at the Republic Executive building, looking for the Chancellor, Palpatine agreed to evacuate as well.<ref name="ZBSB" />

Accompanied by Senator Padmé Amidala, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], they left the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]] through an emergency escape tunnel and boarded the [[Palpatine's H-2 executive shuttle/Legends|Executive Shuttle]] that was piloted by a [[Unidentified Senate Commando (Zillo Beast incident)/Legends|Senate Commando]]. As the shuttle left the docking bay, it was seized by the Zillo Beast. Skywalker cut the shuttle in half, loosening the passenger compartment from the beast's grip. However, the Commando and Palpatine were unable to jump from the falling shuttle. Upon it landing on the ground, the Zillo Beast noticed the Chancellor and the Commando and moved towards them just as R2-D2 arrived. Seeing the Zillo beast come towards them and knowing that R2-D2 could not carry both of them, the Commando forced Palpatine onto the droid to be carried to safety, sacrificing himself as the beast slammed its foot down on top of the shuttle's remains, killing the Commando. With the Chancellor in safety, Republic forces began a bombardment of poisonous gas, killing the beast. The next day, Palpatine, accompanied by robed Senate Guards, ordered the dead beast to be cloned.<ref name="ZBSB" />

===Assassination attempts===
[[File:SenateCommando-Assassin.png|thumb|left|220px|A Senate Commando conducts a sweep]]
Four Senate Commandos were stationed aboard the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] vessel [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] as bridge crew under the command of Captain [[Gray (Coronet captain)/Legends|Gray]]. They were taken by [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|surprise]] and killed by [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] Senator [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]], a secret [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[operative]] who attempted to abduct [[Duke/Legends|Dutchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. The Dutchess was rescued by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Merrik was killed,<ref name="VOT">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref> Later Kryze had a clandestine meeting with a [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Republic Ministry of Intelligence]] agent, [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]]. A [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|Death Watch assassin]] murdered Golec during the meeting, however, [[Unidentified police probe/Legends|the police probe]] that found Kryze noticed that she had a weapon and identified her as a suspect. The Duchess fled, resulting in a chase by the police though Kryze was able to elude them. While the police kept searching for her, she met with Jedi Master Kenobi in [[Coruscant Park]] and gave him a video concerning [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|Republic aid]] for the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]]. With the information in secure hands, she surrendered to Senate Guards at the Senate Building. The video was played for the Senate, resulting in the Duchess's extortion and the resolution of the situation.<ref name="DOM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

A time later, Senate Commandos accompanied Senator Padmé Amidala to the [[Alderaan Conference on the Clone War Refugee Crisis]]. Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano went with them as well after receiving several [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]] that she believed indicated a threat against the life of Senator Amidala. Tano stood with the Senate Guards at the front of the room during the speech. It was at that point that she felt a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]]. Rushing to the walkway above the room, Tano interrupted the bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] shortly before the assassin fired a shot at the senator. The shot struck Amidala in the arm, wounding her though not seriously. The Senate Guards rushed in to cover the Senator as Tano chased Sing. However she lost sight of the assassin. To set a trap for Sing, a [[BD-3000 luxury droid/Legends|droid]] was dressed up in Amidala's robes and entered the meeting room under a heavy Senate Commando guard force. Senate Commandos also swept the corridors and the walkways around the meeting room, ensuring that the area was secure. From her sleeping quarters, Amidala spoke through the droid using a comlink. However, Sing, realizing it was a trap, attempted to kill Amidala in her quarters. She was again interrupted by Tano who used her lightsaber to deflect the bolt. Amidala managed to stun the assassin just as Captain [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] and the Senate Commandos forced their way into the room and placed Sing under arrest.<ref name="Assassin">{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}}</ref>

===Attack on the Senate===
{{Main|Senate hostage crisis/Legends}}
[[File:Senate_Commandos_Hostage_Crisis.png|thumb|right|280px|Senate Commandos in front of the Executive Building.]]
Arriving on Coruscant, Bane's team split up to gain entrance to the Executive Building. Bane, Alama, a sentinel droid, and two [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|droid commandos]] arrived at the building in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], where they were confronted by a squad of Senate Commando guards. From an adjacent tower, Sing distracted the guards with covering sniper fire, taking out most of the Commandos by herself, while Alama and the droids also engaged the Senate Guards. Bane eliminated the guard [[Jayfon/Legends|captain]] and the commando droids dressed up in the Senate Guards' armor to ensure that the fight would go undiscovered. Sing, Robonino, and the [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|sentinel]] [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|droids]] arrived at the scene in a second airspeeder. Leaving both commando droids outside to clear the platform of the dead Senate Guards, the team of bounty hunters made their way into the complex.<ref name="Hostage Crisis">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>

Disposing of a guard stationed at the Executive Building's [[Power control room/Legends|power control room]], the group also destroyed an assistant droid, the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], a [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell]], and the [[R5-S9/Legends|astromech droid]] in the room. Leaving Robonino to sabotage the building's power distribution network, the rest of the team headed to the meeting of senators. On the way to the [[Senate East Wing/Legends|East Wing]] of the building where the senators had gathered, Bane tossed a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] into the Senate Commandos' barracks when two shifts were assembled there. Sing eliminated the only survivor with a shot to the head. The group then entered the Annex Dome, surrounding and taking [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] Senators Organa, Amidala, [[Philo/Legends|Philo]], [[Dantum Roohd/Legends|Dantum Roohd]], [[Zinn Paulness/Legends|Zinn Paulness]], [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]], [[Jakker-Sun/Legends|Jakker-Sun]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> [[Kin Robb/Legends|Kin Robb]],<ref name="VOT" /> and a [[Unidentified Christophsian senator/Legends|Christophsian senator]], as well as C-3PO. Bane made contact with Palpatine who eventually agreed to Ziro's release.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

===Diplomatic functions===
{{Quote|Captain Taggart, we've got incoming clankers!''"<br />"''We'll cover you, sir!|Ahsoka Tano and Taggart|<ref name="FiN">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref>}}
Senate Guards would continue to stand watch over the Senate and Republic Executive buildings.<ref name="HoBS">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> A special honor guard was present at the [[Funeral of Onaconda Farr/Legends|funeral]] of the murdered senator, [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]]. However, the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] was instead called in and the investigation was led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]]. The inspector was given charge of the Senate Guards to assist in protecting the involved senators.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

[[File:OverlookStage-CoN.png|thumb|left|280px|Senate Guards protecting the Festival of Light]]
When Duchess Satine Kryze of Mandalore hosted a [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] on her planet to find a peaceful solution that would end the war between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Captain [[Taggart (Senate Guard)/Legends|Taggart]], several Senate Guards, and Padawan Ahsoka Tano were sent along to protect the Republic delegation, which consisted of Senators Padmé Amidala, Bail Prestor Organa, and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. During the conference, Taggart and some of his men, were stationed at the [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|docks]] with the [[Phoenix (GX1 short hauler)/Legends|''Phoenix'']], the Republic delegation's [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|transport]], while the conference was held in the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]]. However, during that time, Tano, along with the former Separatist, [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], arrived where Taggart and his men were standing guard. Tano had rescued Bonteri from a potential execution by the Separatists for interrupting the peace conference, and the duo was chased by Separatist [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]]. After Tano told Taggart that she and Bonteri were being chased by commando droids, the Captain and his men responded by giving them cover fire to reach the ''Phoenix'', which attracted the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]' attention. Both sides sustained several losses in the following fight.<ref name="FiN" />

Senate Guards, along with shock troopers of the Coruscant Guard and Jedi [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], escorted Chancellor Palpatine to the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] for the upcoming [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]]. One of the Commandos responsible for guarding the Chancellor was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] designated as [[SG-1984/Legends|SG-1984]]. During the ceremony, Cade Bane and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] put their plan into action under the direction of Count Dooku to kidnap Palpatine. Together with their group of bounty hunters which included a disguised Obi-Wan Kenobi as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], they infiltrated the security detail using [[Multispectrum disguise suite|holographic disguise matrices]]. A [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine/Legends|skirmish]] broke out and the Senate Guards moved in to protect Palpatine. However, using the disguise matrix, Eval and Bane were able to seize Palpatine and fled. They were pursued by Kenobi who was able to capture them shortly before the arrival of Windu, Skywalker, and a Coruscant Guard trooper who arrested the two kidnappers.<ref name="CrisisOnNaboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>

Senate Guards also accompanied Senator Amidala on a [[Mission to Scipio/Legends|diplomatic mission]] to the planet [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]] however they had to remain at the gates since the area was a neutral zone under the control of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].<ref name="AnOldFriend">{{TCW|An Old Friend}}</ref>

===The Battle of Coruscant===
During the Battle of Coruscant, Shaak Ti and two other Jedi, along with a clone task force and one Senate Guard came to [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] take the Chancellor to his bunker. Before they could, General Grievous arrived. Shaak Ti, The Chancellor and the other Jedi withdrew from the scene, leaving the task force and the Senate Guard to fight Grievous. The clones and the Guard were swiftly defeated, and Grievous went after the Jedi.<ref name="Chapter 24">{{CW|24}}</ref>

===Last days===
[[File:EpIIISenateGuard.jpg|thumb|right|160px|A Senate Guard in 19 BBY.]]
In the final days of the Clone Wars, the Blue Guard underwent a cosmetic change; the elaborate crests were removed from their helmets, and the open face was covered by a black visor similar to that of the Red Guard.<ref name="GAW" />

Following the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the post of Supreme Chancellor was removed by Palpatine who declared himself [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. This change saw his Red Guard becoming the new [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] that saw to his protection. Furthermore, the proliferation of clone forces led to the Guard being largely redundant and they were gradually phased out of service.<ref name="Senate Guard" />

By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the Senate Guard had been re-established as the [[Imperial Senate Guard/Legends|Imperial Senate Guard]]. Members wore armor identical to the Royal Guard and the [[Emperor's Shadow Guard]], albeit blue in color. Additionally, like the Royal and Shadow Guards, Senate Guards of this era utilized [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pikes]], possibly indicating that they were [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]]. They still functioned as bodyguards (and possibly enforcers) of Imperial Senators while serving the Emperor's will. [[Galen Marek]] would fight many [[Imperial Senate Guard/Legends|Imperial Senate Guard]] during his part in the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Hasbro]] toys name the Senate Guard as the Coruscant Guard. The "Coruscant Guard," however, was initially made up entirely of clones, whereas the Senate Guard had no clones among the ranks. It is possible that the misnomer could have been due to the fact that the Coruscant Guard were also assigned to protect the Republic Senate facilities and all senators in residence, augmenting, but not supplanting, the non-clone Senate Guard already in place.

A [[Unidentified Quarren informant|Quarren]] is mentioned as working for the Coruscant Guard in [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] however this is most likely referring to the Senate Guard.<ref name="ObiwanGuard" />

When the Senate Guard first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']], they were intended to be the direct predecessors of the Royal Guard.<ref name="Shades">{{SWArchive|url=episode-i/bts/design/f20000313/index.html|text=Shades of Blue and Red}}</ref> However, this idea was abandoned in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], where the Senate Guard appears side-by-side with the Red Guard, the direct predecessors of the Royal Guard.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>
